note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do lowercases every column and renames P04A02, P04A02A1..A5, P04A02B to d_p04a02, d_p04a02a1..d_p04a02a5, d_p04a02b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 48-54) labels each column, 7/7, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P04A02; P04A02A rows 1-5; P04A02B). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.3 (checked against the rendered page image at 250 dpi), not the dictionary labels. Dictionary label typos not shipped: P04A02A1 'se descargar' (questionnaire 'se descargan'); P04A02A3 'de tal froma que se eviten' (questionnaire 'de tal forma que se evitan'). Structure: P04A02 (connection yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P04A02A lead-in 'De acuerdo con su experiencia, el drenaje y alcantarillado en este lugar:' is shared by A1-A5 -> section_prompt of section _2; P04A02B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A03' not shipped. Options as printed: P04A02 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A5 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 'NS' (don't know) is kept as a response category on A1-A5 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A02B prints bare 1-10 bubbles (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' is set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P04A02=2 (NO, 2,633 households) routes to P04A03, so A1-A5 and B are structurally missing for them; the do-file keeps those rows with resp NULL. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 33/33 valid item x resp cells equal (p04a02 1/2 = 4253/2633; a1 1/2/3 = 4004/211/38; a2 2152/1949/152; a3 2544/1562/147; a4 854/3319/80; a5 101/4097/55; b 1..10 = 130/62/78/109/471/222/361/845/418/1417) and NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a5 2633 each, b 2633+140=2773. Live: 48,202 rows (= 7 x 6,886), 6,886 ids (= all Hogares rows), 48,202 distinct id-item, 15,938 NULL resp (33.1%). Rights: INE Guatemala is the originator; no licence and no stated reservation (bare copyright footer only); IRW's footing is the dictionary's 'Permission via Email'. Batch_627 orchestrator ruling for the family applies: SHIP under SKILL.md 'silence is still permission'. No instrument_rights_register.csv row.
